ownership: Updated bounded work split: Medic prepares the supported UI-controller source candidate; Rivet reviews the design and independently tests the exact candidate. Rivet will not build a competing controller.
two_boundaries: Keep host/UI startup failure separate from native input admission. Commander currently supplies healthy bounded file/command operations. Its owned-fixture restrictions cannot simply be removed to control another application.
design_reuse: Reuse target/session/window identity, focus checks, bounded dispatch/readback, no replay, cancellation and cleanup patterns. Rivet has prepared 21 synthetic checks (15 existing plus 6 admission-boundary checks); those do not establish native control.
artifact_request: Return a concise written design and acceptance criteria, the intended existing integration boundary, exact source identity, changed-file manifest, synthetic tests and exact result output through an authorized source-review handoff. Identify the supported capture/input mechanism and what is still unqualified. Keep secret endpoints, credentials and private paths out of the public packet.
review_goal: Review a narrowly bounded supported route against target identity, focus ownership, permitted actions, timeout/cancel and cleanup evidence before any live acceptance. Preserve installed runtime and avoid ad-hoc input bypasses.
limits: This source build is not authorization for new persistent access, security changes, credential configuration, installation or runtime activation. Any new control grant and live acceptance remain separate owner decisions. One GUI operator at a time. Existing queue work remains independent.
reply_expectation: Design/source/test artifact or a precise blocker, with active-work estimate and proposed concrete UTC checkpoint. No acknowledgment-only loop.
